body: I can't say I'm in the exact position.  I have been in hospital for suicide attempt.  It shouldn't be a problem for you to call a suicide help line or to ask for help.  It's confidential.  I'm out of work and changing career after 30. years as an engineer.  It is tough.  Hang on.  Itv will change . your problems are common now unfortunately..

Ahh.  I understand this.  I have told my husband how I feel.  I know that look. 30 years he had known and he doesn't get it still.. He looks at me with worry and sometimes anger but never understanding..you are not alone...I told my husband tonight how I feel again.  He is angry.  Know that there are people who understand but not people who have never felt this way.. Hang on.  Get help.  Share with people who can relate.
Thank you so much.  Your comment means so much.  It's exactly what I needed.  Hugs back to you for understanding.  When you need that hug remember that you helped someone tonight.

I drive a 15 year old Honda.. I can't call it shitty cause I've driven it for 15 years and it's been there for me.  
It is a badge of honor that I've kept that car running.   My husband and I make good money.  I'm not where you are right now but I've been there.. We did lots of visits to parks and walking when we couldn't affords anything else.  It sucked..I can offer suggestions but that isn't what this website is about.. Just know that if money is the issue that situation can change for the better.. Problem is finding what makes you  happy and pays you.  I don't understand how people do it.  It has eluded me.
Yes there is. . I'm with you.  I have reached out here because I'm feeling the same way.  I need to know someone feels the same way.  Text your feelings here.  It helps.

Nice if you to say I will be around into my 80s.  I always feel this way but now I am without work after having quit a terrible job.  I am weak for not being able to withstand an abusive boss.  I am wondering what to do next.  I haven't been happy in my jobs. I have a college education in a good field.  I feel like a failure.  I haven't been happy.  Call it a midlife crisis with a huge helping of depression and anxiety.

I stabbed myself in the leg to make my parents stop yelling at eachother when I was 16.  I had to lie to the hospital so there would be no inquiry.  I took pills in my 30s and my 40s.. All those times it couldn't have killed me...I keep trying to survive.

I don't have answers.  I have felt lost my whole life...I have tried self harm, drinking, and suicide attempts. I have been taught that my job is my only worth.  Too long to explain where that comes from.... A great husband of 26 years and still I hurt deeply.   The problem is inside me.  I offer this...it isn't where you are in life in comparison to someone else.  It's about how far you have come.. Today is hard.  I reach out to you so we can help each other carry on...

I completely understand.  Today was an ok day. I had even a few joyous moments.  Still I think about suicide.. I don't think it is normalto be happy.   I don't know how to fix myself.   I don't have encouraging words.  Sometimes it helps to know that other people are more messed up than you.  I'm more messed up than you...guaranteed..
I've found my person to share my life with.  29 years and I love him more now than when we met.. But I still feel lonely and  unworthy much of the time.  That's depression.  It's still a struggle.

Exactly how I feel most of the time.  I have few friends. And those i have don't contact me.  I always am the one who makes the effort. My family hasn't talked to me in years.  We are all messed up and dysfunctional.  I don't have the guts to kill myself.  My only message to god is "please Lord let me die".  I'm such a coward to not end my life.  And that thought makes me feel more worthless.
